text:
anya: quick heads-up — I'm drafting the RN blurb for tomorrow's rollout. want to lock messaging and pin the runtime version.
sam: thanks. can you paste the short TL;DR here so marketing can review? :eyes:
anya: sure —
anya: "New: improved batching heuristics and fallback routing to reduce tail latency; minor kv-cache bugfix; pinned v2.14.3 for API customers."
leo: v2.14.3 ok with infra? any DB migrations or config toggles?
maria: no db migrations. just a config flag for cache-ttl that we should call out — default stays the same.
jamie: marketing wants 1 sentence about customer impact. try: "Redwood responses will be ~15% faster for long-context requests with no change to output quality."
sam: that works. also add a note about pinning: who signs off?
anya: ops-oncall, can you confirm the pin and rollback lanes?
ops-oncall: confirming. we'll pin model/runtime v2.14.3 for hosted, dedicated will remain on v2.14.2 for 24h by policy, then we'll sync. if canary shows regression -> immediate roll back to v2.14.1.
ops-oncall: canary plan: 2% traffic -> 10% after 30m -> 25% after 2h assuming no errors.
leo: any special alerts to watch?
ops-oncall: watch error-rate, token-latency p50/p95, and cache-miss rate. I'll add dashboard widgets.
anya: deploy-bot, schedule deploy for TOMORROW 09:00 PT to match comms window.
deploy-bot: @anya scheduled rollout: release/2026-03-21-09:00-pt -> canary 2% (v2.14.3). commands:```/deploy release/2026-03-21 --canary=2 --owner=@anya```
jamie: copy review: marketing OK with the sentence. add an internal note: "If canary error-rate > 1% absolute increase, ops to rollback and notify eng-releases."
sam: do we need to surface KMS/HSM key rotation for Private customers?
maria: not in this minor, but adding a blurb that Private customers must coordinate with their infra lead for any key changes is fine.
anya: updated RN draft — dropping here for final signoff.
anya: "Release notes (internal): v2.14.3 — improved batching heuristics; KV cache bugfix; runtime pin for hosted customers. Canary rollout starts 09:00 PT. Rollback to v2.14.1 on regression. Dedicated customers stay on v2.14.2 for 24h. No DB migrations. Contact ops-oncall for incidents."
sam: approved. jamie approved. ops-oncall: approved. leo: approved.
anya: thanks everyone — I'll post the internal announcement at 08:30 PT and handoff to ops for the deploy. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: I'll be on watch and will post status updates in #incidents if anything unusual pops up.
